16 teams participated in the '''1996–97 Egyptian Premier League season'''. The first team in the league was the champion, and qualified to [[CAF Champions League 1998|CAF Champions League]], while the runner up qualified to the [[1998 CAF Cup|CAF Cup]]. The season started on 20 August 1996 and concluded on 25 August 1997.
[[Al Ahly SC|Al Ahly]] won the league for the 26th time in the club's history.<ref>[[:ar:الدوري المصري الممتاز 1996–97]]</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://drtareksaid.net/SocDawry9697.html|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210131195909/http://drtareksaid.net/SocDawry9697.html|url-status=usurped|archive-date=January 31, 2021|title=Dr.Tarek Said's Homepage - Egyptian League 1996/97|website=drtareksaid.net}}</ref>
